predicate.label: dismissed person from role
predicate.definition: Person or institution X fired or dismissed person Y from a professional or official role.
excludes: X taking Y's role without evidence of dismissing Y
dismissing an argument rather than a person from a role
ambiguous: replace where removal versus succession is unresolved
predicate.notes: The dismissing actor need not become the successor. This is separate from succeeded_person.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit firing or dismissal; clearly terminating Y's role; historical dismissal. Excludes: criticizing or blaming alone; X taking Y's role without evidence of dismissing Y; ordinary departure or voluntary resignation; dismissing an argument rather than a person from a role. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: replace where removal versus succession is unresolved; a proposed firing without realization; unclear actor or dismissed person. The dismissing actor need not become the successor. This is separate from succeeded_person.

rationale: Fire/dismiss is the largest family (five rows), exceeding replace (four). Manager X removes Y from position; X need not be Y successor.
